title: Custom evidence-state builder
boundary: This builder does not parse arbitrary natural language and does not implement closure logic. It maps bounded selections to public frozen CFC Anchor API inputs using synthetic, case-scoped trust fixtures.
notes: DISTINCT provenance does not itself prove independence.
VERIFIED independence installs an explicit synthetic host-authority attestation over E1/E2 through the frozen public API.
The builder does not offer a contradictory VERIFIED-independence + SHARED_LINEAGE combination.
STALE changes the evidence validity window; WRONG changes the Controller audit scope input.
All final closure decisions come from frozen control_closure, not from this schema or the browser.
